name: suite-agent
body: A thing that uses the system: the opencode suite agent (spec-writer, plan-writer, agent-builder, and the repo-defined implementer/reviewer agents) that authors the durable spec through the apg_node / apg_edge tools. It issues bursts of node/edge mutations — sometimes as parallel tool calls — and must never see a lock failure, must never lose a mutation that reported success, and must not have to know whether a session coordinator is running: the tool surface is identical either way. Interest: a parallel authoring burst is as reliable as a serial one, and a crash mid-session leaves the durable spec intact.
